project_type: TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepo (shared/backend/frontend/infra). Issue #22 is a FRONTEND-only UX change (React + Vite SPA) plus docs/spec updates. No backend or infra behavior change.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts in package.json: build (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra), test (per-workspace vitest), test:e2e (-w @mlb/frontend playwright), synth (build frontend then cdk synth). node/npm may NOT be on PATH; prefix PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (confirmed working; node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2).
test_framework: Vitest for unit/component tests, colocated as *.test.ts(x) in each workspace. jsdom env + @testing-library/react in frontend (src/test/setup.ts). Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts (headless chromium, --no-sandbox, offline via @mlb/shared seed fallback + page.route stubs). Playwright config: frontend/playwright.config.ts (port 4318, webServer runs `npm run build && npm run preview`).
test_command: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test  (runs vitest in every workspace). For e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build (ordered build must stay green). 2) npm test (all workspaces; add new frontend unit/component tests). 3) npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (Playwright; chromium must be installed first via `node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install chromium` from repo root). 4) npm run synth (cdk synth regression guard, no AWS calls). Do NOT run cdk deploy; no live Bedrock/MLB calls.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Vite build output frontend/dist is gitignored. Playwright screenshots land in frontend/test-results (gitignored). Dark-mode screenshots captured in e2e are for visual inspection, not committed snapshots.
setup_instructions: Root node_modules already installed (vitest + playwright CLI present at node_modules/.bin). Chromium browser is NOT yet installed (~/.cache/ms-playwright empty) - run `node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install chromium` (or `npx playwright install chromium`) once from repo root before e2e. Install @axe-core/playwright into the frontend workspace: `npm install -D @axe-core/playwright -w @mlb/frontend` (registry reachable; @axe-core/playwright@4.13.0 resolves).
environment_constraints: Network allows npm registry (confirmed `npm view @axe-core/playwright` returns 4.13.0). No AWS calls, no live Bedrock/MLB calls. e2e runs headless chromium with --no-sandbox (already configured in playwright.config.ts). Stay on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; make incremental commits. Do NOT push, open PRs, or deploy.
contribution_requirements: .kiro/steering/*.md is inclusion:always and graded: (1) incremental commits; (2) spec-driven dev - update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements.md,design.md,tasks.md}; (3) keep README.md AND README.ja.md truthful (both must describe dark mode + a11y accurately); (4) all three test layers (vitest unit, property, playwright e2e) must stay green; (5) tests added in the same change as behavior. Conventional-commit style messages (feat/chore/docs/fix/refactor) scoped like `feat(issue-22): ...` matching existing history.
key_patterns: Persisted header toggle precedent: LanguageToggle (frontend/src/components/LanguageToggle.tsx) + i18n context (frontend/src/i18n/index.ts) persist to localStorage key 'mlb.lang' with a guarded readStored/store helper safe under jsdom. Mirror this for theme: localStorage key 'mlb.theme' with values 'light'|'dark'|'system'. All colors in frontend/src/styles.css are hardcoded hex / a handful of CSS custom props on :root (--navy, --red, --ink, --surface, --bg, --border, etc. with `color-scheme: light`). TeamBadge (frontend/src/components/TeamBadge.tsx) hardcodes fill="#ffffff" for the abbreviation text - replace with a computed readableTextColor(primary). teamColors.ts (frontend/src/teamColors.ts) is the TEAM_COLORS table (14 teams) + DEFAULT_COLOR, exported via teamColor(id). i18n messages live in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (MessageKey union + MESSAGES.en/.ja) - add theme keys to BOTH the union and both language tables. SVG assets (frontend/src/assets/*.svg) hardcode white strokes/fills - ensure legibility on dark bg. Header is rendered in HomePage.tsx; AccuracyPage.tsx and SeriesDetailPage.tsx are separate pages that also need theme coverage. Theme must be applied app-wide (set data-theme on documentElement) so all three pages/routes inherit it - do it in main.tsx bootstrap and/or a ThemeProvider mounted above the Router.
directory_structure: frontend/src: components/ (BracketView, SeriesCard, TeamBadge, LanguageToggle, PredictionPanel, StandingsPanel), pages/ (HomePage, SeriesDetailPage, AccuracyPage), i18n/ (index.ts context + messages.ts dictionary), assets/ (committed SVGs), styles.css (single global stylesheet, light-only CSS vars on :root), teamColors.ts (14-team color table), main.tsx (bootstrap: BrowserRouter > I18nProvider > App). frontend/e2e: Playwright specs + fixtures.ts (offline seed + route stubs). Header UI lives in HomePage.tsx (brand, LanguageToggle, accuracy nav link, hero); AccuracyPage/SeriesDetailPage render their own simpler headers/nav.
